title: Unholy DK — how a Gladiator bursts
summary: A 4x Gladiator Unholy DK: Blinding Sleet, then Army, then Dark Transformation within a second, because Dark Transformation empowers the Army already out.

evidence.note: 26 Sep 2026 · one player (4x Gladiator) in Walking Dead · every player a Gladiator

sections.title: Why Army goes first: four talents set the order
sections.body: Commander of the Dead: Dark Transformation gives his Lesser Ghouls and Magus +25% damage for 30s, so the Army is out first. Gift of the San'layn: inside Dark Transformation his strike becomes Vampiric Strike, his biggest hitter. Reaping: Dark Transformation resets Soul Reaper and lets it hit any target. Forbidden Knowledge: Army turns Death Coil into Necrotic Coil for 30s.

steps.note: 1.3s before Army, 5 of 9 times: disorients those in front as the ghouls arrive.

sections.title: Burst: offensive cooldowns, all within three seconds

steps.note: Starts the go. Forbidden Knowledge: Death Coil is Necrotic Coil for 30s.
Within 1s of Army, 7 of 9: Commander of the Dead gives the Army +25%.
About 1s later, 6 of 9: Reaping just reset it and lets it hit any target.
About 2.4s after Army. Necrotic Wounds: absorbs 8% of their healing, up to 3.

sections.title: Burst: what fills it, and why then

steps.note: 73% inside Dark Transformation (Gift of the San'layn). 14% of his damage.
Every one inside Army. Pressed near full runic power: median 86 of 100.
Outside Army: spends runic power at a median 76 of 100, before it caps.

sections.title: Burst: crowd control and the kick on their healer

steps.note: 4 to 10s after Army, in 4 of 9 bursts: as the damage peaks.
On their healer inside the burst: both kicks in a killing peak were his.

sections.title: Land the burst on their healer's CC
sections.body: The DK and Monk usually burst together. It killed when their healer was locked out or kicked during those 6 seconds (3 of 5 at this level) and rarely when their healer was free (1 of 7). His build, the same in all 7 games, is attached: open it above. Life and Death punishes a dispel of Dread Plague: 6% of his damage. The full comp read is in the Walking Dead guide.
